name: Susan Rubio

items.text: A former Baldwin Park city attorney's plea agreement, unsealed December 2024, alleges an unnamed official sought $30,000 in cash for a 2018 state campaign. The LA Times reported only Rubio fits the description. She isn't named or charged and denies taking bribes. Her spokesman says the FBI told her she isn't a target.
items.why: This is a serious, undecided accusation of bribery and illegal campaign money, which bears on criterion 6 (abuse of office or self-dealing). She is not named or charged, and the investigation is reportedly ongoing.

for_review: I did not read the sealed or unsealed plea agreement itself. The facts come from the LA Times (via AOL), a RealClearPolitics piece (via Yahoo) and the DOJ press release. The DOJ release doesn't name Rubio. The RCP piece says the Senate Ethics Committee declined Essayli's complaint because of a rule against allegations more than three years old, so that was not a finding on the merits. The same piece says Rubio told CBS in January 2025 "I'm not saying that" when asked whether she denied being Person 20. Rubio's spokesman says the FBI told her she is not a target, but the U.S. attorney's office would neither confirm nor deny it. The RCP piece also raises a separate, undecided question about whether Rubio properly used her legal defense fund and campaign committee money to pay lawyers in her ex-husband's defamation suit. Her office says it was proper. It is reported by one outlet with legal-expert comment, and I did not check it against FPPC records. The owner-sites search (Alex Jones, Stew Peters, Ryan Dawson, Infowars) returned nothing about Rubio. I searched only once, and results about Marco Rubio were irrelevant. The search tool showed no results from those sites.
